Counts at every stage of the routing and safety pipeline.

Perturbation families broken down by clinical domain; KUB degrades most.
The robustness execution reproduces the frozen clean predictions exactly, with zero TEST reads and zero training.
Accuracy against analytical compute. ReMedFiLM FULL has its own marker; the earlier report version omitted it.
Measured per-component latency. Skip and execute paths bracket the FULL system's cost.
Accuracy against parameter count on a log axis; ReMedFiLM achieves its score with far fewer parameters than DeepLabV3+.
Per-seed macro Dice and Δ Dice with the across-seed mean and SD band. The backbone is identical across seeds, so this is not end-to-end replication.
Empirical bootstrap distribution of the paired macro Δ Dice on VAL808; the whole distribution lies above zero.
